objective: Computation. Glue planar knot spaces beyond the census (plane cubic bipartite incidence graphs of 10 and 12 points grown from the cube by ladder moves, with Kasteleyn signs, both readings) to census knot spaces along a simple 3-edge cut. For every removal on the planar side, classify the knots crossing the opened cut as generated by eliminations from one-sided knots, or new; one new knot refutes the conjecture. Record also the census (every ordered pair) and the four-pattern interfaces. Method: Kasteleyn signs make the knot fail (failure equals sign-nonsingularity on the census).
status: Proved by HANDLE-EMERGENCE-20261102-001A-P001 (finite classification): planar removed sides create nothing beyond the census. 24 planar knot spaces of 10 to 14 points (ladder growth, prisms, truncated octahedron; Kasteleyn signs, failure checked) spliced into K4^(3), census 6, Fano and census 58: 1612 removals, 724 six-pattern, 432,867 crossing knots, none new. Census: planar sides 0 of 560; Fano and census 58 create 936 at 100 of 208; no four-pattern interface creates (1400)
title: A planar removed side creates nothing
